description: Returns a short-lived (5-min) download URL for a bulk Parquet object that can be piped directly into Python/DuckDB/Polars for high-throughput computation that exceeds the MCP context window. The URL streams the object straight from Valuein storage and supports HTTP range reads, so `duckdb.read_parquet(url)` / `pl.read_parquet(url)` work without downloading the whole file first. Datasets: fact (per-entity partition — requires ticker), ratio (all computed ratios, including the 'valuation' category's price-free reference values graham_number and ncav_per_share), filing (SEC filing metadata), references (company universe), index_membership (historical index composition). For intrinsic value use compute_dcf. Scoped to the caller's tier bucket; the link is signed and cannot be used to list the bucket or read other objects.

dataset_type.description: Dataset to access. 'fact' requires ticker (per-entity partition). All others are full-universe tables.

ticker.description: Required when dataset_type is 'fact'. Resolves to the per-entity fact/{CIK}.parquet partition for that company.

name: get_compute_ready_stream

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

scope.description: What the presigned URL is scoped to (method, object_key_only, etc.)

url.description: Signed, time-limited (5-min) download URL for the Parquet object (Range-enabled)

title: Compute-Ready Stream
